outcome: Instrumental birth (cesarean section or vaginal instrumental birth)
Use of obstetric interventions (pain relief or augmentation)
cohort: Low-risk births in primary care midwifery practices in the Netherlands from 2008-2010
finding: A high intrapartum referral rate in a midwifery practice is associated with an increased chance of an instrumental birth for nulliparous women, which is mediated by the increased use of obstetric interventions.
